items.transcript: I would measure retry volume first and keep writes idempotent so replay does not duplicate orders. I would show the product manager the observed delay, but I have not estimated the throughput cost.

relevance.quote: I would measure retry volume first and keep writes idempotent so replay does not duplicate orders. I would show the product manager the observed delay, but I have not estimated the throughput cost.
